items.title: Great Listeners, Poor Decision-Makers: Rethinking Agentic Audio AI

evidence.quote: Evolutionary tuning. Choosing tools, their order, and their thresholds is a combinatorial design problem with conflicting objectives. For a tool chain and its gate parameters π \pi , we seek the Pareto set of

namely task error, latency, wrong-action rate, and clarification rate. Multi-objective evolutionary algorithms such as NSGA-II [ 23 ] return a set of trade-offs rather than one solution, so a designer can pick a conservative configuration for emergency response and a fast one for media control. Unlike prompt and workflow search for text agents [ 78 , 79 ] , this search must also weigh real-time latency and the cost of acting on misheard speech.The gate’s membership functions form a small, continuous parameter vector well suited to evolutionary search, which Section III-B tunes for error cost and ask rate.

Inputs matter more than the algorithm, and fuzzy gates are the most robust (C7). At matched ask rates, the tuned gates and the calibrated product gate differ in utility by at most 0.01, and their fronts overlap between 30% and 70% ask rates (Fig. 8 ). The tuned threshold gate reaches the largest hypervolume ( 0.779 ± 0.001 0.779\pm 0.001 , against 0.754 ± 0.021 0.754\pm 0.021 for the tuned fuzzy gate and 0.753 0.753 for the calibrated product curve), mainly because it also reaches very low ask rates. Fuzzy gates differ in robustness: with overconfident addressedness, the tuned fuzzy gate executes 4.5 ± 2.1 4.5\pm 2.1 % of side talk, against 7.2 7.2 – 13.0 13.0 % for the non-fuzzy gates that use all three evidence terms, because its rules route intermediate addressedness to a question. The interval type-2 gate lowers this to 3.1 ± 1.2 3.1\pm 1.2 %, a difference from type-1 that is not significant (paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test over ten seeds, p = 0.084 p=0.084 ). Two cautions apply. The untuned hand-written fuzzy gate performs worst of all gates (utility 0.32; 7.4% wrong high-risk actions under an overconfident recognizer), so expert rules must be tuned on data. And a single-objective evolution strategy that maximized expected utility converged to a gate that never acts and asks 78% of the time, so user burden must be optimized as a separate objective.

items.reason_zh: 独立重读 Table VII/VIII 后确认：NSGA-II 用执行错误成本与澄清率反复搜索外部动作门控的阈值/隶属参数，选定策略用于后续留出 episode；属于离线 Harness 控制策略优化，非模型权重训练。
limitations_zh: 离线门控参数优化，固定后测试；不是在线自主改写提示或代码。
录音数据没有真实澄清应答，q=1 或 q=0.8 是明确评估假设，不能当作真人交互成功率。
门控效益不等于一个连续自演化代理系统的完整实证。
items.next_step_zh: 按 Harness/component 纳入，摘要保留离线控制策略搜索边界。
items.summary_zh: 以多目标演化搜索调优语音代理的动作门控，在错误风险与澄清成本之间选择策略。
items.summary_en: Multi-objective evolutionary search tunes external action-gating policies for audio agents, selecting trade-offs between action risk and clarification cost.
